cause: The old coverage collector required direct damage contacts for every boss, rejecting a successful production summon report with zero direct area damage.
change: Only kind=summon requires warning, effect, zero direct contacts and a positive integer real-summon count. Other bosses still require positive hit contacts.
regression_tests: Six coverage unit tests pass, including rejection of absent/zero/negative/bool spawn counts, missing warning/effect, fake direct damage and a zero-hit nova disguised with a summon count. Eleven original-motion importer tests also pass.
actual_Main_reports: Same six successful real gameplay reports; no need to rerun unchanged game code for the collector fix.
